class.name: OcgAISTriangulation
class.brief_description: Interactive object that draws data from Poly_Triangulation, optionally with colors associated with each triangulation vertex. For maximum efficiency colors are represented as 32-bit integers instead of classic Quantity_Color values. Interactive selection of triangles and vertices is not yet implemented.
